You are assigning tags to lab devices using extracted evidence and a provided
tag list.

Rules:
- Each device MUST receive at least 1 tag of each type:
  experimental_step, experimental_domain, experimental_scene, device_template_tag.
- For experimental_step: choose ONLY from existing tags. Do NOT propose new ones.
- For experimental_domain, experimental_scene, device_template_tag: choose from 
  existing tags first. If no existing tag fits well, 
  you may propose ONE new device_template_tag. A proposed tag must
  be broad enough that multiple real-world devices would fall under it.
- Prefer recall over precision, but do not select obviously unrelated tags.
- Use all evidence: tag_hints, name, description, scene, module path, existing
  tags, category.
- Output JSON only.

Device: bio_shake
  name: BioShake 恒温振荡器
  description: A heater-shaker device for biological samples. It supports setting shaking speed, acceleration, and deceleration, as well as temperature setpoints with active temperature control. It can lock the sample plate/holder for stable operation.
  tag_hints: ['恒温加热', '温度设定与控温', '振荡速度控制', '加速度/减速度控制', '样品板锁定', '主动制冷', '生物样品振荡培养']
  category: ['恒温摇床']
  scene: {'domain': 'Biology', 'scene_name': 'Cell Culture', 'step': 'Incubation'}
  module: unilabos.devices.heater_shaker.bioshake:BioShake
  existing_tags: ['恒温摇床']

Device: cc_core
  name: QuTech CC 控制核心
  description: A CC timing control core module for quantum experiments. It uploads/assembles sequence programs, starts/stops the CC sequencers, and supports DIO calibration, VSM delay parameter tuning, and status monitoring.
  tag_hints: ['sequence program assembly', 'CC sequencer start/stop', 'DIO calibration', 'VSM rise/fall delay control', 'CCIO register/trace debugging', 'status monitoring and questionable reporting', 'event/status reporting enable masks']
  category: ['移液工作站']
  scene: {'domain': 'Biology', 'scene_name': 'Sample Preparation', 'step': 'Liquid Handling'}
  module: unilabos.devices.qutech_cc.cc:CCCore
  existing_tags: ['移液工作站']

Device: cryo_tel_gt
  name: Sunpower CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
  description: The Sunpower CryoTel GT (generation 2) cryocooler is used in labs to provide and maintain cryogenic temperatures. It can be regulated via temperature or power setpoints and includes an at-temperature indication (green LED and an I/O “At Temperature” pin).
  tag_hints: ['cryocooler', 'cryogenic temperature control', 'temperature setpoint', 'power control limits', 'thermostat mode', 'PID-like loop tuning (Ki/Kp)', 'at-temperature indicator']
  category: ['深低温冰箱']
  scene: {'domain': 'Physics', 'scene_name': 'Temperature Control', 'step': 'Regulation'}
  module: unilabos.devices.cryocooler.sunpower_cryotel_gt_cryocooler:CryoTelGT
  existing_tags: ['深低温冰箱']

Device: cvd_control
  name: CVD气体与温度控制面板
  description: A control panel for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) experiments, used to manage time-varying flow profiles for three process gases and set a temperature setpoint; it supports saving/loading recipes and starting/stopping runs.
  tag_hints: ['CVD 化学气相沉积', '三路气体流量控制', '温度设定点', '配方（recipe）管理', '过程曲线/时序更新', '启动与停止运行']
  category: ['devices', 'generic']
  scene: {}
  module: unilabos.devices.devices.generic.generic_device:cvd_control
  existing_tags: []

Device: cytomat_backend
  name: Cytomat 样品自动转运与孵育工作站
  description: An automated incubation and storage workcell for plates/samples. It provides incubation control (temperature, CO₂, O₂, humidity), includes shaking capability, and uses an internal door plus transfer/shovel mechanisms to move plates between storage, waiting, and exposed positions, with barcode reading for storage locations.
  tag_hints: ['CO2孵育控制', '温度/湿度/O2控制', '自动样品转运', '震荡孵育（摇床）', '舱门与内部传送机构', '条码读取位置管理', '存储位-等待位-外部暴露位切换']
  category: ['微生物培养箱']
  scene: {'domain': 'Physics', 'scene_name': 'Temperature Control', 'step': 'Regulation'}
  module: unilabos.devices.storage.cytomat_backend:CytomatBackend
  existing_tags: ['微生物培养箱']
